## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Python tests and lint passed when applicable
- [ ] Terraform formatting and affected environment validation passed
- [ ] Kubernetes overlays rendered and validated when applicable
- [ ] Security scans passed or an approved exception is documented
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs were updated when applicable

## Risk and operations

- [ ] Security and IAM impact reviewed
- [ ] Cost impact reviewed
- [ ] Rollback or recovery path documented
- [ ] Production changes require explicit approval
